title: Not Worth Your Money Or Time!
text: Not Worth Your Money Or Time!. Hmmm where to begin..... I bought this to replace my bathroom cabinet. I thought it would be larger and more sturdy. Its a lot smaller than it looks in pictures. It also isnt sturdy at all. Its made of cheap metal and cheap plastic. It def. wont work for my bathroom at all because of these two man issues. The quality control stickers are stuck all over it and also the end pieces on the top dont fit well. I had to hammer it all into place which just made it more unsturdy. I am debating on returning it or if its even worth the hassle. Very disappointed overall.
